Exercise 2 · Example. — bi-kām il-fanūs From? — tusʿumiyya. — tusʿumiyya?! ġāli ʾawi! From nuḥās ʾaṣli, ya bēh. — maʿlēš, iʿmil maʿāya wāgib. ana ḥaddīk ḫumsumiyya. — ḫumsumiyya?! ya fandim, ana kida baḫsar. ēh raʾyak f-tamanimiyya? — ēh āḫir kalām? — sabʿumiyya, wi da āḫir kalām wallāhi. — ṭab, nʾsimha nuṣṣēn: sittomiyya. Sittomiyya w-ḫamsīn, ʿašān ḫāṭrak Bass. — ittafaʾna, ʿala barakit allāh! (The tutor accepts any negotiation with the required formulas and a result close to the goal.) ya bēh - Sir? To the customer. ḥaddīk • • • baḫsar "I'm losing us." Exercise 3. Personal answer. The tutor controls at least four strategies (proposing, reassuring, recognizing and overturning, showing advantage, giving time, humor), for example: ēh raʾyak law nrūḥ il-maʿraḍ Is-sabt? ana ʿārif innak taʿbān, bass il-maʿraḍ ṣuġayyar. ṣaddaʾni, miš ḥatiḫsar ḥāga. wi baʿdēn il-ġada ʿalayya! Exercise 4 · Example (b). Ana ʿāyiz il-igtimāʿ is-sāʿa Tamanya. Tamanya Badri ʾawi ʿalayya, ʿandi l-wilād. ēh raʾyak f-ḥidāšar? — ḥidāšar mitʾaḫḫar, ʿandi ʿamīl is-sāʿa itnāšar. — ṭab ḫallīna nitʾābil f n-nuṣṣ: tisʿa w-nuṣṣ? — tisʿa w-nuṣṣ… māši, bi-šarṭ il-igtimāʿ ma-yiʿaddīš sāʿa. — ittafaʾna. yaʿni tisʿa w-nuṣṣ, sāʿa bass, kida tamām? — tamām. ma-yiʿaddīš "Do not exceed" Exercise 5 · Examples. a) ḥaʾʾak ʿalayya ya fandim, ḥālan ḥašūf il-mawḍūʿ. · b) ʿala ʿēni! Exercise 7. Personal answer. The tutor checks that the moves and outcome match the scene and that the Egyptian summary uses ittafaʾu ʿala… o ma-ttafaʾūš. Exercise 8. a) The tap drips for three days and the kitchen is flooded; The plumber was supposed to come on Sunday. Saʿīd You're right, I'm sorry.ḥaʾʾik ʿalayya), explains that he had a lot of work and the car failed, and promises to come this afternoon, guaranteeing it. 1,000 pounds with work; Umm Šarīf finds the price too high, and the faucet alone costs 700: if you buy it, you only pay for the assembly. Saʿīd asks 300, you offer 250 For me (ʿašān ḫāṭri) and he accepts. b) To work with him on the project to deliver it in two weeks; Mīna has two other projects. Topics: dividing work (calculations to Mīna, drawings to Šarīf); no one on the farm does the calculations better than he does; Šarīf the other draft of Mīna. Three weeks instead of two. Two and a half weeks, with a preliminary version to the customer after two weeks; Mīna asks that Šarīf offer him lunch when he comes to Milan. c) She asked to suspend the line a month ago, but her bills are still coming. At the beginning it is firm (the problem, two previous calls), then decided (it waits not enough) it wants suspension today and reimbursement). Gets: suspension within one hour, request for refund with message within one week, one month free if reactivates the line (and the request number). But this time seriously, not like the two times passed!          □ Unit verification. 1. law samaḥt, mumkin tšūf il-mawḍūʿ From? · 2. ḥaḍritak waʿadtini innak gayy imbāriḥ. · 3. kida ma-yinfaʿš ḫāliṣ. · 4. ḥatāḫud kām? · 5. from kitīr ʿalayya. · 6. nazzil šuwayya. · 7. from āḫir kalām. · 8. ʿala barakit allāh!
